PNP, NAKA-FULL ALERT PARA SA 3-DAY INC RALLY 

Tiniyak ng Philippine National Police (PNP) na naka-full alert ang buong puwersa mula 5 p.m. nitong Biyernes, Nov. 14, kasunod ng inorganisang tatlong araw na rally ng Iglesia ni Cristo mula Nov. 16 hanggang Nov. 18.

Ayon sa pahayag ng PNP, lahat ng yunit ay handa, kumpleto sa tauhan at kagamitan, at nakaposisyon ang kapulisan sa Metro Manila at iba pang key areas sa bansa.

“We fully respect the public’s right to peaceful assembly. In return, we ask everyone to observe safety reminders, cooperate with our officers on the ground, and help keep the environment calm and orderly,” saad ng PNP.

According to PNSP, all units are prepared, complete with personnel and equipment, and in opposition to the Metro and other key areas in the country.
